page.notes: Line numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60 printed in the gutter between the columns; placed at their approximate position. The word "vsi le" at the foot of the left column continues into "gutur," at the head of the right column (leguntur, word split across the column break). Doubtful: "Stettc" (place name, possibly Stette), "tiftitea" at the foot of the right column, the entry "Ioannem Habium & Diethelmum Rostium". The left column's first entries and the right column's first entries are separate printed items; paragraph breaks follow the printed entry ends. The left column's "De salute" line is read as "salus"; the scan may show "falus". Right-column line "vitæ delicet bellis compositis" appears garbled in print.
